title: Muscle roles in modified bridging
subdomain: Modified bridging in this section; not a phase-specific EMG or activation-percentage claim.
summary: In the described modified-bridge activities, trunk flexors and extensors stabilize while gluteus maximus and quadriceps are strengthened. Abdominals cooperate with gluteus maximus to control pelvic tilt; lumbar extensors stabilize the spine against the gluteal pull.
